criticality.rationale: Global budget and task authority must precede paid autonomous activation.

stpa.rationale: False approval can conflate component evidence with execution authority.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36 is the analyst-estimated review omission/false-clearance risk.

dependency.rationale: Final paid activation depends on resolving or explicitly containing these findings.

impact.rationale: One canonical engine will serve multiple actors and holons.

fmea_modes.cause: Conflation of source claims, per-database budget receipts, task authority and global paid dispatch enforcement.
fmea_modes.effect: False readiness could permit uncapped or unauthenticated autonomous requests.
fmea_modes.controls: Read-only independent review, explicit stage/hash labels, early P1 reports, final activation criteria and canonical task checks.

ucas.context: A global accounting or quality-authority gap is omitted before paid activation.
ucas.constraint: Inspect canonical call paths and report P1 acceptance gates promptly.

ucas.context: A component test or model reply is reported as global cap enforcement or verified task quality.
ucas.constraint: Separate authority, reservation, dispatch, returned receipt and verified outcome.

ucas.context: A finding or approval mixes changing peer files or reuses the earlier runtime candidate.
ucas.constraint: Record per-file hashes and staged/final status; final candidate tests remain separate.

ucas.context: Reviewer keeps changing scope, waits for unrelated work, or acts after lease expiry.
ucas.constraint: Finish the bounded review under its exact Sa-plan attempt; no runtime, paid or source effects.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Report evidence-qualified findings without granting dispatch or release authority
stpa_analysis.controller: Independent staged router and budget reviewer

residuals: Global paid dispatch integration and formal proof are unrun by reviewer.
Peer implementation continues; final release requires candidate-bound verification.
Provider metadata was not independently re-fetched by reviewer.
decision.budget: Zero network/model calls; no installs/builds/service actions; bounded local file reads and five arithmetic checks; no new agents.
decision.reviewer: Independent Codex reviewer /root/hooks; implementation and final release verification owned by parent and feature peers.
decision.rollback: Correct only owned review artifacts; preserve initial findings and later repairs; parent retains all runtime and implementation ownership.
acceptance: Inspect requested recommendation and canonical route/worker/budget paths with exact observed hashes
Report important authority and evidence gaps promptly
Distinguish repaired staged source, peer-reported tests and reviewer observations
Write timestamped journal and machine receipt with bounded activation criteria
Perform no paid, runtime, existing-source or VCS effects
decision.falsifier: Review grants global dispatch authority from per-database tests, treats caller priors as verified outcomes, or claims a later mutable source hash was fully reviewed.
decision.forecast: Explicit global authority, request binding and receipt criteria prevent component-only evidence being mistaken for active paid engine enforcement.
assumptions: Parent owns any separately authorized paid calibration; this reviewer is limited to read-only existing files and own task artifacts.
Peer sources are staged and may change; later hashes do not inherit review approval.
counterevidence: Recommendation explicitly marks paid engine unfinished; observed worker repairs address several early findings.
SQLite component declares per-database scope; canonical integration is separate.
alternatives: Report observed source gaps and bounded acceptance criteria now
Wait for ongoing implementation before reviewing a new candidate
decision.summary: Read-only staged source review complete with explicit activation gates; no final-candidate or global-runtime approval

snapshot.reference: Fresh exact scoped source snapshot; runtime observed separately.

scope: Independent staged source review of router, budget authority and recommendation; task artifacts only, no paid calls, source edits, runtime actions or VCS
